stories.title: Amid Anchorage airport growth, some neighbors say more should be done about noise
stories.summary: The Sand Lake Community Council recently drafted a resolution calling for officials to expand the scope of their noise study.

stories.title: Zelenskyy urges US to pressure Putin and questions Trump’s reference to Putin as a ‘friend’
stories.summary: The Ukrainian president described Trump’s comments at a recent summit in China as “strange” because the Russian leader is “an aggressor and a killer.”

stories.title: With an Olympic medal, new skis and a fresh look, Anchorage’s Gus Schumacher kicks off World Cup season
stories.summary: The cross-country ski season for Schumacher and his U.S. teammates starts in Finland this weekend.

stories.title: After retirement of era-defining skiers, U.S. women’s cross country team looks to the next generation
stories.summary: The retirement of both Jessie Diggins and Rosie Brennan has left a gap, but also opened up opportunities for the current crop of skiers.

stories.title: From billions of miles away, Voyager 1 has gone to great lengths in educating Alaskans
stories.summary: Since its launch over 49 years ago, the craft has produced revealing data offering valuable insight to those in labs and classrooms.

stories.title: Democrats vow to restrain Trump’s foreign policy, but foresee limits
stories.summary: U.S. allies and partners want the incoming Congress to be more assertive, but some remain skeptical Trump can be reined in.

stories.title: Proposed Bristol Bay hydroelectric project promises relief from diesel costs, but raises salmon concerns
stories.summary: The Nushagak Electric and Telephone Cooperative wants to build a hydroelectric plant at Nuyakuk Falls, about 60 miles north of Dillingham, without damming the river.

stories.title: Nearly 3 years after its Peter Pan plant closed, King Cove could see new revenue from its fuel farm
stories.summary: Silver Bay Seafoods says it’s working to expand fleet support services next year to include storage, vessel repairs, and other assistance.

stories.title: Democrat Evelynn Trefon wins Southwest Alaska House District 37 seat
stories.summary: The results tabulated by the Division of Elections will remain unofficial until a review board certifies the election on Nov. 25.

stories.title: No whale entanglements reported in Aleutians last year, but tracking depends on local sightings
stories.summary: The last reported whale entanglement in Unalaska was in 2024 when boaters were warned about an entangled whale in Nateekin Bay.

stories.title: 48-star U.S. flag opens conversations about history at Unalaska veterans gathering
stories.summary: The flag is believed to have been flown during the Aleutian Campaign, the only WWII campaign fought on North American soil.

stories.title: Alaska students can help name the ‘Trusty Tusty’ replacement ferry
stories.summary: There’s one catch, though. State law says Alaska ferries must be named after Alaska glaciers, and there are 745 to choose from.
